text: A scheduled run (06:33 UTC) drafted finance/sbir-draft.md, but its push failed with 403: the routine has no access to this repo. The draft exists only in that run's container, so M05 stays pending here until the founder gives the routine repo access or recovers the draft.
start
Read finance/grants.md (funding map, 11 programs, NIDILRR/NIH/NSF shortlist, fit notes, caveats that agency pages were not readable)
Read ethics/irb-packet.md (pilot protocol: 80-150 managers, cluster-randomized, T-arm vs C-arm, partner IRB needs)
Read docs/founder-decisions.md (country and ownership undecided; accounts such as SAM.gov/eRA authorised later by founder)
WebFetch of acl.gov, nsf.gov and sbir.gov was blocked by the network egress proxy; will verify rules via web search snippets and mark anything not seen on an official page as unverified
Also blocked by proxy: grants.nih.gov, seed.nih.gov, simpler.grants.gov, seedfund.nsf.gov; only WebSearch snippets from official-domain results are available. Not bypassing the block.

Searched NIDILRR SBIR, NSF 26-510 and NIH parent SBIR notices; got NIDILRR FY26 NOFO HHS-2026-ACL-NIDILRR-BISA-0207 (95-100k, 10 grants, 6 months, due 2025-12-15), NSF up to 305k and due dates, NIH PA-27-100 with 2027-01-05 receipt date, NIH registration list

Found FY2027 NIDILRR forecast HHS-2027-ACL-NIDILRR-BISA-0308 (11 grants, 95-100k, 6 months, est. post 2026-10-16, est. due 2026-12-16, est. start 2027-06-01); forecast only, NOFO not posted as of today

NSF Phase I budget snippet: fee 7%, SBIR at least two-thirds of budget to small business, Project Pitch has 4 sections (500/500/250/250 words); NIH Specific Aims 1 page, Research Strategy 6 pages for Phase I

Found NIH rules via search snippets: PD/PI primary employment >50% with small business, normally at least 67% of Phase I work by the small business and at most 33% third-party; NIH Phase I normally 6-12 months; NIH salary cap 228,000 from 2026-01-11 (NOT-OD-26-034); NSF registration order SAM then S

Verified via snippets: NIH fee normally at most 7% of total costs (NIHGPS 18.5.4); de minimis indirect up to 15% of MTDC since 2024-10-01 (2 CFR 200.414); BLS 2025 disability employment-population ratio 22.8% vs 65.2% (release 2026-03-03); NIH clinical-trial definition; overlap/duplicate-award discl

Plan: one master draft with Tier A (NIDILRR 6-month, 100k ceiling, N=40 wave) and Tier B (NIH/NSF 12-month, N=120, under 305k); bottom-up budget with labelled assumptions and a stdlib Monte Carlo (P10/P50/P90) on cost and on the 1/3 third-party limit
block: Build interrupted by the usage limit at about 07:20 UTC with a partial draft on disk; rebuild queued after the current verification wave
unblock: Usage limit cleared; rebuilding from the partial draft
start
Read role card, brief packet, grants.md, founder-decisions.md and the partial sbir-draft.md (v0.1, 31 KB, Tier A NIDILRR and Tier B NIH/NSF)
Plan: re-verify rules on official sites (previous run was proxy-blocked), re-run cost model so appendix reproduces 5.3, fix arithmetic, finish draft v0.2
Read irb-packet.md (all 239 lines): protocol, consent, debrief, stop rules, data management, risk-benefit, partner IRB needs, claims check
WebFetch of simpler.grants.gov, seed.nih.gov, nsf.gov, sbir.gov, acl.gov, grants.nih.gov, seedfund.nsf.gov all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED by the network proxy; not worked around
Falling back to web search snippets for rule checks; rows keep V1 (official-domain snippet), V2 (secondary) or U (unverified) tags
WebFetch also blocked for aahd.us and simpler.grants.gov (EGRESS_BLOCKED); only WebSearch result text is available this session

NIH parent SBIR notice: search results say PA-27-100 is SBIR (R43/R44, clinical trial optional) and PA-27-102 is STTR, which contradicts grants.md; receipt dates 2026-09-05, 2027-01-05, 2027-04-05 (aggregator sources)

NIDILRR: could not find HHS-2027-ACL-NIDILRR-BISA-0308 in two searches; found FY2026 listing HHS-2026-ACL-NIDILRR-BISA-0207 and a DRRC letter dated 2026-08-10 reporting 36 FY2026 NIDILRR competitions removed

NIH Phase I cap: most recent NIH-issued figure found in search is $314,363 (NOT-OD-25-013), above the draft's $306,872; one 2026 third-party guide lists $323,090 with no NIH notice found. Cap marked unverified; Tier B ($269k) fits under all three
13 CFR 121.702 current eCFR snippet says more than 50% owned and controlled by US citizens or permanent residents, tested at time of award; VC-owned route only if agency elects it

SAM lead times: NSF says up to one month; NIH says SAM 3+ weeks and all registrations 6+ weeks; SBIR.gov FY26 instructions mention a notarized Entity Administrator letter and up to 10 business days to activate

NIDILRR: ACL snippets confirm award ceiling includes direct, indirect and fee; FY2025 aggregator lists a 40-page project narrative cap (FY2027 unverified); aggregator notes Section 508 and WCAG 2.0/2.1 AA expectations for digital outputs

Indirect rules: NOT-OD-25-059 snippet says NIH keeps SBIR/STTR on NIHGPS 18.5.4.3 (use federal rate if held; de minimis recognized for non-SBIR awards); a Princeton summary of NOT-OD-26-072 says NIH reverted to 10% de minimis and $25k subaward base. Draft's 15% indirect becomes a sensitivity, not a

Verified by search snippet: BLS 2025 employment ratio 22.8% vs 65.2% (bls.gov); Nario-Redmond 2017 abstract (Rehab Psychol 62(3):324-333) also reports empathic concern rose in both experiments and simulated dyslexia, hearing, mobility, low vision (not ADHD)

NSF 26-510: windows 2026-07-27, 2026-11-04, 2027-03-04, 2027-07-07 and max 2 Project Pitches per company per year (aggregators); Project Description 15 pages comes only from an undated forum post, so unverified

Re-ran cost Monte Carlo (python3 stdlib, 20,000 draws, seed 20261007, common random numbers across indirect scenarios). Tier A base P10/P50/P90 $89,128/$95,683/$101,739, P(within $100k)=0.82; Tier B $253,986/$271,967/$288,150
Hand-checked draft section 5.1 and 5.2 arithmetic against script: mode totals $93,530 (A) and $269,441 (B) reproduce; third-party shares 30.7% and 31.7% reproduce
Indirect-rate sensitivity: at 10% indirect Tier B third-party share P(<=33%) falls to 0.41 (mode 33.1%); at a 40%-of-direct stress case both tiers exceed their caps (A $114,058, B $328,601 at mode)
